goal: Let a Full Access admin connect CrowdStrike Falcon and configure how CrowdStrike-sourced signals weight into each user's Dune risk score.
constraints: CrowdStrike module licensing varies per client tenant (Falcon Insight core, Identity Protection, Spotlight, Discover are separately licensed)
CrowdStrike's data model is device/identity-keyed, not user-keyed, requiring a mapping layer
RBAC currently offers no admin persona narrower than Full Access for a security-tooling-owner use case
Existing risk score recompute follows a scheduled cadence, not real-time
assumptions: One CrowdStrike tenant (Client ID/Secret) maps to exactly one Dune organization
End users should see only a summary of what drives their score, not raw CrowdStrike detail
Weight changes apply on the next scheduled sync rather than instantly
All CrowdStrike categories, including device/environment signals, blend into one overall risk score rather than a separate human vs. environment score (confirmed with stakeholder)
Users with zero CrowdStrike coverage are scored under a distinct 'No Endpoint Visibility' weight rather than excluded or treated as neutral (confirmed with stakeholder)
RBAC scope for this feature is Full Access admin only for v1 (confirmed with stakeholder)
gaps: No definition of how the CrowdStrike contribution mathematically combines with existing training/simulation risk score
No normalization scheme across ZTA scores, detection severity, vulnerability counts, and account hygiene flags
No exact scoring/escalation math defined for the new No Endpoint Visibility weight
No employee-facing disclosure update described for the new data source
No bulk resolution path for user mapping at scale
Capability re-detection behavior after a license change is unspecified
No success metric or rollout signal defined anywhere in source material
edge_cases: First activation full sync of a large user base with no progress indication
Partial per-category sync failure (one scope fails while others succeed)
Previously available category becomes unavailable after a license downgrade
Zero unmatched identities vs. very large unmatched identity list
Weight set above 0% for a category with no synced data yet
Disconnecting the integration with no confirmation step
All weights set to 0% functioning like an undeclared disconnect
Re-linking an already-mapped identity to correct a mismatch

critical_questions.question: How does the weighted CrowdStrike contribution mathematically combine with the existing training/simulation risk score, and is there a cap on score movement per sync cycle?
What is the normalization method for turning ZTA scores, detection severity, CVE counts, and account hygiene flags into a common 0-100 sub-score before weights are applied?
What is the exact scoring/escalation math for the No Endpoint Visibility weight?
Does this feature require updating employee-facing risk score transparency messaging to disclose the new data source?
Can a Dune organization connect more than one CrowdStrike tenant (multi-CID enterprises)?
Is a bulk resolution path needed for user mapping at scale, or is one-at-a-time linking acceptable for v1?
Does capability detection automatically re-run when a client's CrowdStrike license changes, or is it a manual admin action?
Is there any defined success signal for this feature that should shape build priority?

design_risks: Score volatility from CrowdStrike-driven changes undermines the platform's calm-authority trust tone if changes are large, frequent, or unexplained
Folding device/environment posture into a 'human risk' score risks feeling arbitrary or unfair since users don't control patch cadence or sensor health
Coverage bias: users without full CrowdStrike coverage (BYOD, contractors, exempted execs) score differently for reasons unrelated to actual risk
Unconstrained independent weight sliders with no recommended defaults make misconfiguration easy and its downstream effects invisible
Requiring Full Access to configure a security-tooling integration mismatches real-world ownership and may stall enterprise adoption
No admin-facing warning when saved weights would shift Smart Group membership or fire Adaptive Workflows automation
teaching_notes: Reuse the existing risk score badge and Critical/High/Medium/Low scale from knowledge/design-system-rules.md for any CrowdStrike contribution breakdown; never show a raw sub-score without the badge treatment
The 5-category weight configuration should be a full settings page, not a modal or drawer, per design-system-rules constraints on form length
knowledge/features/rbac/prd.json already has an open, unresolved question about a Super Admin distinct from Full Access; this feature is a concrete forcing function for that decision
Reuse the scheduled-polling snapshot-diff sync model already used elsewhere for risk-score-triggered automation rather than designing a bespoke sync UX
Extend the 'who will this affect' preview pattern used for group-targeted automation to cover Smart Group and Adaptive Workflow cascades when weights are saved
